data.description: An isitoq's nerves form grotesque wings. Any creature struck by the creature's wings must succeed at a DC %1 Will save or be dazed for 1 round as the target's mind is flooded with images of the last seconds of the isitoq's existence as a living creature. This is a mind-affecting fear effect.
data.name: Daze
